scope: SYNTHETIC engineering qualification; not physiological validation

gates.causality: light raises receptor voltage and lowers both downstream voltages relative to darkness
gates.null: disconnecting the first edge or silencing receptor release removes downstream light-dark difference exactly
gates.missing: unassigned receptor input equals darkness exactly; no anatomical interpretation
gates.parity: sim.run and chunked CpuRuntime graded potentials and counts are bit identical
gates.replay: deterministic repetition and checkpoint/restore are bit identical
gates.convergence: maximum final-bin voltage error at dt=0.05 relative to dt=0.025 is less than at dt=0.1 and below 0.1 mV for light and dark
gates.spikes: all three graded neurons emit zero spikes

failure_rule: preserve every failed gate; do not tune this fixture after execution
physiology: UNKNOWN: no measured release curve, adaptation, noise or independent physiological comparator; do not score T4/T5 or behavior
